introduction: India has three distinct agricultural/cropping seasons based on the monsoon and temperature changes. The type of crop grown heavily depends on the water and heat requirements during these specific months.

core_concepts.title: Kharif Season (Monsoon Crops)
core_concepts.description: These crops are sown with the onset of the monsoon (June/July) and harvested at the end of the monsoon season (September/October). They require high temperature and high humidity/water.

core_concepts.title: Major Kharif Crops
core_concepts.description: Rice (Paddy), Maize, Cotton, Jute, and Groundnut.

core_concepts.title: Rabi Season (Winter Crops)
core_concepts.description: These crops are sown in winter (October/November) and harvested in the summer (March/April). They require a cool climate for growth and a warm climate for seed maturation.

core_concepts.title: Zaid Season (Summer Crops)
core_concepts.description: A short season during the summer months (March to June) right between the Rabi and Kharif seasons. These crops rely heavily on artificial irrigation.

core_concepts.title: Major Zaid Crops
core_concepts.description: Watermelon, Muskmelon, Cucumber, Vegetables, and Fodder crops.

important_entities.name: The Two Pillars
important_entities.significance: Always anchor your memory on the two staple foods. Rice requires standing water (Monsoon = Kharif). Wheat requires cool weather (Winter = Rabi).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: If asked about sugarcane, note that it takes almost a full year (10-12 months) to grow. While it is generally classified as a Kharif crop, it spans across multiple seasons.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Kharif = Kharab (Bad Weather/Rains) = Rice. Rabi = Rajai (Blanket/Winter) = Wheat.
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Use Hindi associations: Rains bring 'Kharab' roads (Kharif/Rice). Winter makes you use a 'Rajai' (Rabi/Wheat).

exam_strategy_tips: Direct matching is the most common question: 'Which of the following is a Rabi crop?' Memorize Mustard and Gram as Rabi, and Cotton and Groundnut as Kharif.
Zaid season questions almost always feature 'Watermelon' or 'Cucumber' as the answer.
